subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants / vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) DJP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a952113440bde6b91889f1fec4cc70d83890ad1c65e6778da885076fda640c.png] 

Option 2) SYE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf118c491cbba09e4b8e1159da62595576c96110dcbbfecd73e8e7734ec4364d.png] 

Option 3) MUI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afef76f30dd76173b05357a2202e0756ae2f48a75cb33685261fe1d107623519.png] 

Option 4) AGM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc727c9101f94c96987761030f24517561e5d75faac314cce34b35af3dab5b0.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'MUI' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
